name: items
description: Footer links, rendered as a list. Omit entirely rather than passing placeholder `#` links — a link that goes nowhere is worse than no link.

name: visuallyHiddenTitle
description: Accessible heading for the link list. Defaults to `Support links`.

name: text
description: Additional text below the links, for example a department name.

name: html
description: Additional content as HTML. Takes precedence over `text`.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the footer.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the footer.
